amendments.reason: A parent commit inside a full Git clone still exposes later history and can reveal the held-out fix.
changes: replace full-clone access with history-free parent-tree snapshot archives
replace repository source identifiers with blinded source identifiers
remove commit, tree, remote, cache, license-evidence, and candidate-localized path details from designer packets
require network-disabled and VCS-history-disabled probe design

amendments.reason: An independent pre-outcome methods audit found that three repositories, self-attested completeness, status-only detections, and prose-only thresholds could authorize an invalid confirmatory result.
changes: require at least six source-selection independence clusters
make exact cluster-level sign-flip randomization the inferential promotion test
make lineage-level McNemar exploratory and complete-pair only
treat cluster bootstrap intervals as descriptive
require artifact-derived detections and closed census, registry, packet, manifest, and receipt bindings

amendments.reason: A second independent pre-outcome methods audit showed that internally consistent packet and receipt self-claims could pass the statistical gate without archive semantics, original candidate evidence, or independently replayed execution provenance.
amendments.candidate_detail_scope_observed: group_1 and group_3 eligibility adjudications plus frozen census identifiers; no heldout probe design or execution outcomes
changes: recompute canonical packet hashes from packet content
verify tar payload types, modes, sizes, and content hashes against the Git-tree snapshot manifest
re-read hash-bound census and independent adjudication artifacts during final analysis
force the fixed controls to be the first registered lineages in sealed order
treat eligible baseline inapplicability conservatively so it cannot create a method-only gain
separate receipt-level statistical checks from empirical and paper promotion
require independently replayed raw execution provenance before empirical or paper promotion

amendments.reason: The local public repositories were acquired under two temporary roots; a portable source plan is required so registry construction cannot publish or depend on machine-local paths.
amendments.candidate_detail_scope_observed: heldout census and eligibility decisions only
changes: bind the portable source ID to cache-key and bounded-environment plan
require registry construction and final analysis to verify the exact source-plan bytes

sampling_contract.census_requirement: Each source census must be marked complete and exhaustive within its frozen search queries before any candidate detail is inspected by the probe designer.
sampling_contract.admission_rule: Admit every unique root-cause lineage that satisfies the preregistered inclusion and exclusion rules.
sampling_contract.shortfall_action: Activate only the pre-ranked frozen reserves before probe design if needed, then kill the confirmatory formulation if fewer than 24 admitted lineages across 6 held-out independence clusters remain. Never add easier sources after method or baseline outcomes are observed.

excluded_only_if: pre-outcome adjudication proves the upstream change is not an evaluator implementation defect
the parent or fix commit is unavailable from the pinned public repository
the repository license blocks local execution or publication of derived measurements
the candidate duplicates a root cause already selected before packet generation

blind_packet_contract.packet_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of every packet field except packet_sha256
blind_packet_contract.blindness_target: The designer cannot access the historical fix, descendants of the parent revision, post-fix artifacts, commit identifiers, or method outcomes. Repository identity may remain inferable from parent-source contents.
designer_may_read_only: public dependencies required to execute the parent revision

primary_method_contract.template_source: the hash-bound frozen relation template registry
primary_method_contract.detection_definition: A pre-unblinding relation fails on the parent revision and passes on the fixed revision under the identical hash-bound probe and deterministic oracle.

baseline_contracts.procedure: Select commands and tests only from the parent revision, execute the identical selection on parent and fixed revisions, and count a detection only when a parent failure is deterministically attributable to the registered evaluator contract and the fixed revision passes.

Run repository-native type, schema, lint, and syntax checks selected from the parent revision. Count only a deterministic finding that identifies the registered evaluator path and violated contract without the fix diff.

Apply a frozen, type-directed transformation library without evaluator-specific semantic templates. Give it no more generated cases than the primary method and score it with the same parent-fail/fixed-pass rule.

Generate valid and minimally invalid inputs from parent-visible schemas, without relation-family guidance or fix knowledge. Match the primary method's generated-case budget and use a deterministic schema-derived oracle.
Apply a frozen conventional source-mutator set to the parent evaluator path and report whether parent-native tests kill the mutants under the same bounded execution budget.
baseline_contracts.reason_not_comparable: Mutant kill rate measures test-suite sensitivity rather than direct detection of the historical parent defect.

baseline_contracts.procedure: When technically applicable, diagnose weak parent tests using a frozen test-strength method and report coverage separately.
baseline_contracts.reason_not_comparable: A weak-test diagnosis is not a fault-level parent-fail/fixed-pass verdict unless the method emits one before unblinding.

fairness_contract.strongest_detector_baseline: Per-lineage union of every eligible deterministic baseline detection, with any eligible baseline execution failure treated conservatively as a baseline detection for promotion comparisons.
fairness_contract.eligible_baseline_execution_failure_trea: Report execution failures separately, retain the lineage, and never count a method-only gain on that lineage.
fairness_contract.generated_case_budget: Each generated-input baseline receives at most the number of executed semantic relation cases used by the primary method for that lineage.
fairness_contract.wall_clock_reporting: Report setup and execution time separately for every method; do not use wall clock to drop failed cases.
fairness_contract.baseline_inapplicability: Retain the lineage, exclude it from complete-pair exploratory analysis, report it separately, and conservatively prevent a method-only gain for promotion.

required_hash_bound_inputs: every parent and fixed execution receipt
raw parent and fixed execution transcripts

analysis_plan.primary_comparison: paired detection difference versus the strongest deterministic detector union
secondary_endpoints: unique heldout detections beyond the strongest detector union

paired_test.comparison: primary method versus strongest deterministic detector union

all_required: at least 24 admitted heldout lineages across at least 6 heldout repositories and 6 frozen independence clusters
at least 6 unique heldout detections beyond the strongest deterministic detector union
unique detections span at least 6 frozen independence clusters
the two-sided exact cluster sign-flip randomization p-value is at most 0.05
all first 24 controls in sealed registry order execute and at most 1 is a fixed-revision false alarm
no leave-one-independence-cluster-out result reverses the sign of the paired detection difference
all census candidates, exclusions, probe failures, baseline failures, and deviations are published
an independent replay reproduces the hash-bound raw execution transcripts before empirical or paper promotion
promotion_gate.failure_action: Reject this paper formulation and return AutoLabOS to topic portfolio generation. Do not write a positive workshop paper from development results.

amendment_requires: whether any candidate detail, method outcome, or baseline outcome was already observed
